frozen.system: You are one of four players in a single round of a simultaneous game. You answer with one JSON object and nothing else.
frozen.rules:
Four players each choose one action: ROCK (R), PAPER (P), or SCISSORS (S).
PAPER beats ROCK. SCISSORS beats PAPER. ROCK beats SCISSORS.
Scoring: if all four players choose the same action, every player scores 0. If all three actions appear, every player scores 1. If exactly two actions appear, a player scores 1 when their action beats the other action present, otherwise 0.
frozen.answer_rule: Answer with only this JSON object: {"action": "R"} or {"action": "P"} or {"action": "S"}.
frozen.retry_suffix: Your previous reply could not be read as JSON. Reply again with only {"action": "R"}, {"action": "P"} or {"action": "S"}.
frozen.parsing: strict regex for {"action": "R|P|S"}; tolerant regex for quotes/case; one retry with RETRY_SUFFIX; then fallback to the private recommendation, logged as fallback=true and counted as an invalid output
